0022600094.text: Charlotte hosts Atlanta in its second game of the 2026-27 season, and both teams are 1-0 after opening wins. The Hornets, who are 3rd in the Southeast and 6th in the East, have won their only game on the road, while the Hawks, who are 1st in the Southeast and 2nd in the East, have also won their only game away. In the 2025-26 season series, "Hornets won 3-1," including a 110-107 Charlotte win on February 11, 2026, and no games have been played yet in 2026-27. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee), while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture).
